title: Condado Residence
description: A beachfront apartment called for window treatments that could stand up to salt air and strong afternoon light without sacrificing elegance. Custom-lined linen curtains in a warm ivory diffuse the Caribbean sun across the open living space, while motorized blackout panels in the bedrooms offer complete privacy at the touch of a button. Every detail was coordinated with the interior architect to ensure the hardware, fabric weight, and pleat style felt native to the space.
